info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector OrderItems API
Microsoft Azure Get Subscriptions Subscriptionid Providers Microsoft Edgeorder Orderitems

params.name: $filter
params.description: $filter is supported to filter based on order id. Filter supports only equals operation.

params.name: $expand
params.description: $expand is supported on parent device details, device details, forward shipping details and reverse shipping details parameters. Each of these can be provided as a comma separated list. Parent Device Details for order item provides details on the devices of the product, Device Details for order item provides details on the devices of the child configurations of the product, Forward and Reverse Shipping details provide forward and reverse shipping details respectively.

params.name: $skipToken
params.description: $skipToken is supported on Get list of order items, which provides the next page in the list of order items.

params.name: $top
params.description: $top is supported on fetching list of resources. $top=10 means that the first 10 items in the list will be returned to the API caller.

items.docs: List order items at subscription level.
